column1: # Stage S11a, agent J2b — xtask's contract codegen and font-table generator, its schema gates and
# the ORBAT slot flattening become the schema_tooling crate; the ballistics catalog trim becomes the
# ballistics_oracle_tooling crate. The `schema` command line and its dispatch stay in the xtask
# binary. The crate roots, the schema gates' one-line module file and the moved code's own
# `crate::` paths are written by hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# schema_tooling: the generators (contract codegen, font table)
# schema_tooling: the contract schema gates; their folder README becomes the crate README
# ballistics_oracle_tooling: the module becomes the crate; its module root becomes the crate root
# consumers in xtask name the crate that now holds each module
